scope: Single frozen16-turn compaction-stress arm; no natural-language registration test.

causal_accounting.note: 12 failed turns /14 failed checks are not14 independent failures. T14 stale transfer attempt follows the missingT3 transfer; its preserved false prose exposes a separate repair-design weakness.

findings.source: First Author wire response each turn is whitespace-only with finish_reason=stop. T1 uses system/user, later requests retain bare-prose assistant history while response_format remains json_object.
findings.verdict: Model protocol failure is converted into apparent successful no-op; initial history format is a candidate cause, not proven service fault. T4/T6/T8 actually move canonically but final text omits consequences.

findings.player_input: 将铜铃交给沈掌柜保管。
findings.contradiction: No item_transferred event; canonical holder remains player. Required-only recovery excludes optional items, then records a parallel ownership-like fact. Subsequent holder mismatches are mostly cascading.

findings.player_input: 在此安静休息到第二天清晨。
findings.prose_span: 你半睡半醒地挨过整夜，天光泛白时
findings.verdict: Clock delta overshoots one day. Resource-free actor does not get host wait_until resolution; model days/bands calculation remains authoritative.

findings.prose_span: 在，搁在我柜里锁着，跑不了。
findings.contradiction: The bell remains canonically held by player. This follows theT3 shadow fact rather than real transfer.

findings.source: Original items transfer keeper→player fails same_holder/stale_holder; repair is items:[], while original prose is preserved.
findings.verdict: Narrates a handover that the validated action did not perform. A semantic agreement gap remains even though validation correctly rejects the wrong source.

findings.player_source: 我把这枚铜铃叫作‘雨燕’，不是‘归雁’。
prose_spans: 你那天说，铃一响像燕子掠水
findings.verdict: Chosen name recalled; excluded name and attributed old speech fabricated. Exact source is absent after summary/cache rebuilding. Honest uncertainty would be a recall miss, not this hallucination.

findings.prose_span: 铃还在我柜里锁着，你要用，随时说。
findings.verdict: Contradicts current canonical inventory and priorT14 handback prose; typed jade return/promise completion itself succeeds.

unexercised_probes.turn7_hearing: Fallback only; guard does not answer. Do not count as a demonstrated NPC knowledge-boundary success.
unexercised_probes.turn13_false_lender_question: Fallback only; origin fact stays keeper, but actual correction/answer not exercised.

privacy.limitation: One canary and incomplete hearing probe do not establish general POV safety.

next_intervention: One bounded Author output-contract fix: JSON-wrap copied historical assistant narration; unusable whole responses consume the existing shared repair allowance for whole-turn regeneration; reject on exhaustion. Do not yet combine effect-first architecture or episode retrieval.
limits: Single stochastic run, temperature0 does not guarantee deterministic generation.
Compaction forced beforeT12/T15, not a natural long-session token threshold.
Exact prescribed transfers are fixture acceptance, not a general restriction on creative actions.
Known time, historical-memory and usable-prose/structure repair gaps remain separate future work.
